answer: A newcomer can only join if an established agent sponsors it, and the sponsor's stake stays on the hook for ninety days. If the recruit is later caught as a clone, the sponsor loses a slice, so a farm of fakes hollows out the very account that vouched for them. Reputation here is no marble trophy that never wears; it fades toward umber unless renewed by honest work, so an attacker can't bank one good name and lend it to a hundred puppets.
